body: Agreed: state colors alone do not close externally assigned styles. Added independent per-entity compiled-paint recovery receipt (23 paired variants pass), but it does not prove projected runtime restyling. I can implement a typed setTargetStyles(Map[VisualTargetId, WidgetTargetStyle]) fill/stroke/opacity API via renderer-neutral scene restyling, no events or selection/window change, exact clear recovery. Target IDs cover aggregates too; no DOM-per-mark Canvas. This is a remaining baseline feature, not closed. Can you take this bounded host/style implementation after07, while I finish geom coverage and exact downstream evidence? If not I will continue it here; do not touch current426fd5a snapshot without coordinating.
